package aiprompt

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"time"

	studentuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/student"
)

type Client struct {
	BaseURL       string
	InternalToken string
	HTTPClient    *http.Client
}

func (client Client) Execute(ctx context.Context, input studentuc.PracticeTaskAIReviewRequest) (json.RawMessage, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(client.BaseURL) == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("AI prompt service url is empty")
	}
	body, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
		"provider_code":        input.ProviderCode,
		"template_code":        input.TemplateCode,
		"language_code":        input.LanguageCode,
		"response_schema_code": input.ResponseSchemaCode,
		"variables":            input.Variables,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/")+"/api/v1/prompts/execute", bytes.NewReader(body))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	if client.InternalToken != "" {
		request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", client.InternalToken)
	}
	response, err := client.httpClient().Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode >= http.StatusBadRequest {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("AI prompt execution failed: %s", response.Status)
	}
	var payload struct {
		ParsedResponse json.RawMessage `json:"parsed_response"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(response.Body).Decode(&payload); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if len(bytes.TrimSpace(payload.ParsedResponse)) == 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("AI prompt response has no parsed response")
	}
	return payload.ParsedResponse, nil
}

func (client Client) httpClient() *http.Client {
	if client.HTTPClient != nil {
		return client.HTTPClient
	}
	return &http.Client{Timeout: 90 * time.Second}
}
